description: On the table in front of you are a white dustpan, a purple scoop near the back wall, a small yellow bulb-shaped item, and a tiny gray toy, with a blue die sitting in the purple scoop. The left hand stays resting near the center while the right hand reaches forward to the purple scoop, grasps the blue die as a right-hand object, lifts it out, moves it down and right over the white dustpan, and releases it to leave the die sitting in the dustpan.
